headline: 9 on-chain Solana addresses catalogued from spl-stake-pool deployment; no GitHub, no audits, no governance forum found; DeFiPunkd read API unsupported for Solana.

findings.text: D1: Solana has no canonical EVM block explorer with name-tag search. Solscan fetch was allowlist-blocked. Solana Compass (a community Solana explorer) surfaced the Phase Delegation stake pool at aero2ePURjuEgLKTzcUmF6RypBncBGd7pMUYCoSsVJ6 with 9 labelled addresses. The spl-stake-pool program (canonical Solana Foundation on-chain program) is used.

D2: phase.cc/delegation fetched — rendered minimal marketing copy with no deployed-addresses table. phase.cc/stake fetched — references $YIELD LST but no on-chain addresses listed. No canonical deployed-contracts doc found; protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null. Gitbook docs at phase-labs.gitbook.io/phase-labs surfaced via search (tiered delegation strategy content confirmed) but not fetchable as a first-class URL in this run.

D3: No audit links pinned in per-protocol context and none discovered via website, search, or Gitbook snippet. The spl-stake-pool underlying program has been audited by Neodyme, OtterSec, and Halborn (per SPL repo release notes), but no Phase-specific audit report was found.

D4: No GitHub repo recorded in per-protocol context. Search did not surface a Phase-owned GitHub repo. Gitbook reference (phase-labs.gitbook.io) found but GitHub source repo not discoverable from available fetches.

D5: protocol.chains lists only Solana. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana chainId. Solscan and Solana explorer direct fetches were allowlist-blocked. Only Solana Compass (community explorer) was fetchable. No multi-chain expansion needed.

D6: The stake pool is not a factory. Validator list account aero4efZ7zHhWpqXQj4Uqw59koxj8KXqMCPUuvmhgUQ holds references to 97 active validator stake accounts (epoch 1003) per Solana Compass; these are leaf validator stake accounts, not protocol contracts. Enumeration capped and not recorded individually per D6 cap rule.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: stake pool (pool), manager/staker (admin/owner — same address), stake deposit authority (other), pool withdraw authority (other — PDA), validator list storage (other — PDA), pool mint/token (token), manager fee account (treasury), reserve stake (vault). Actor classes unknown for manager/staker address; PDAs are program-derived and not independently controlled.
D8: All 9 addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to the fetched Solana Compass URL. No snippet-only sightings without a full-fetch source.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked phase.cc website (2 pages fetched), Solana Compass stake pool page (full fetch with all addresses), and 4 search queries. 9 on-chain Solana addresses were catalogued from the spl-stake-pool deployment. No GitHub repo, no protocol-specific audits, no governance forum, and no deployed-contracts docs page were found. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana, so on-chain reads could not be performed via the standard tooling; Solana Compass served as the primary on-chain data source.

Phase Stake page confirms liquid staking token branded $YIELD (previously pdSOL) and native staking via Phase Stake validator; no on-chain addresses listed on this page.

D2: No canonical deployed-contracts docs page found on phase.cc or phase-labs.gitbook.io from this run; deployed_contracts_doc set to null.
D4: No GitHub repository for Phase / Phase Labs discovered; protocol.github is empty and no repo surfaced from search or website fetches.
D3: No Phase-specific audit report found; spl-stake-pool underlying program audits (Neodyme, OtterSec, Halborn) are at the program level, not Phase-pool-specific.
D5-offchain: DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana chainId; on-chain reads (manager actor class, reserve stake balance, validator list enumeration) not performable via defipunkd.com tooling.
D6: Validator list account aero4efZ7zHhWpqXQj4Uqw59koxj8KXqMCPUuvmhgUQ holds 97 active validator stake accounts not enumerated individually; Solana read API unavailable via DeFiPunkd.

D8: phase-labs.gitbook.io/phase-labs and aeropool.io were surfaced only via search snippets and could not be fully fetched (not in allowlist from prior results); recorded in evidence[] as derived/snippet-only — admin_addresses not extended from these sources.

protocol_metadata.about: Phase Delegation (formerly AeroPool) is an institutional-grade Solana liquid staking protocol operated by Phase (phase.cc) since 2021. Users deposit SOL and receive pdSOL (also referred to as $YIELD), a liquid staking token representing their pooled stake, while the protocol delegates to 97+ validators chosen for their contributions to the Solana ecosystem. The pool uses the canonical spl-stake-pool on-chain program and follows a tiered delegation strategy that prioritises smaller, emerging validators to promote decentralisation. As of epoch 1003, approximately 1.09 million SOL is staked through the pool at a 5.14% APY, with a 5% rewards fee and 0.05% deposit/withdrawal fees.
